title: 第5章 肋骨断三根第6章 灵药失窃叶风监守自盗
lines: 云霜儿前脚刚走，叶风的眼睛便睁开了。
看到云霜儿骑着仙鹤已经飞远，他这才松了一口气。
“幸亏刚才装死，否则小命肯定不保啊！”
他挣扎起身，看着胸前皮肤上发红的脚印。
“都是同一个门派，下脚咋这么狠！
再说了……这事儿也不怪我啊，你自已大半夜跑到这里，什么都不说就脱衣服，我是被逼观看，我也是受害者……哎呦，疼死我了！”
如火烧一般的刺痛，让叶风觉得肯定是受了内伤。
他赶紧内视查看，发现自已断了三根肋骨。
好在断裂的骨头并没有刺破内脏，短时间内不至于要命。
但疼是肯定的，且没办法继续赶路了，只要动作稍大一些，就疼的要命。
这里没有大夫，叶风只能展开自救工作。
忍着剧痛，折断很多根细直的树枝。
然后又将衣服撕成了一段段的布条，彼此连接，当做捆绑的纱布。
做完这一切之后，他咬着一根木棍，盘膝而坐，进入内视状态。
然后通过手掌抚摸加内视，确定了三根断裂的肋骨。
最后慢慢的将断骨进行复位。
断骨部位每一次轻微的触碰，都会引起剧烈的疼痛，仿佛千万根钢针刺入骨髓，让人无法忍受。
疼痛如烈火般在身体内燃烧，周围的肌肉与神经似乎也受到了波及，让叶风连呼吸都变的十分困难。
好在他最终还是凭借着咬碎口中木棍后，发出的几十声杀猪般的惨叫，承受了过来，将三根断骨全部复位。
此刻叶风脸色惨白，额头，脸颊，脖子上都是汗珠。
“真他娘的疼啊！”
他稍作休息，然后便拿起先前收集起来的木棍，当做固定板，用连接在一起的布条当做纱布，进行缠绕固定，以免断骨再度移位。
做完这一切，他已经累的快脱虚了，他将身体慢慢的平躺下来，看着清晨练习御剑飞行的弟子，在苍穹形成的彩色流光，大口的喘着气。
随着身体慢慢的稳定下来，那种火焰灼烧一般的痛苦也慢慢的减弱了一些，但还是很疼。
于是，叶风便想到运功疗伤。
虽然他不知道修炼法门，不过，原主是第三层百脉境的修为，距离御剑飞行境界只差临门一脚，丹田内的真元灵力还是有一些的。
叶风闭上眼睛，不断的调整呼吸，然后慢慢的调动经络与丹田内的灵气，缓缓的滋润断骨处。
顿时间，一股清凉的感觉袭来，疼痛感立刻消减大半。
看到这方法果然管用，叶风心中大喜。
“我他娘就是个天才啊！”
民间有句俗语，伤筋动骨一百天。
这只针对于没有修为的凡人。
content_en:
As soon as Yun Shuang'er stepped forward, Ye Feng's eyes opened.
He breathed a sigh of relief when he saw that Yun Shuang'er had flown far away on the crane.
"Fortunately, I just pretended to be dead, otherwise my life would have been in danger!"
He struggled to get up and looked at the red footprints on the skin of his chest.
"They are all from the same sect, why are they so cruel!
Besides... you don't blame me for this. You came here in the middle of the night and took off your clothes without saying anything. I was forced to watch, and I am also a victim... Ouch, it hurts me so much! "
The burning pain made Ye Feng feel that he must have suffered internal injuries.
He quickly looked inside and found that he had three broken ribs.
Fortunately, the broken bones did not puncture the internal organs, so it would not be fatal in a short time.
But the pain is certain, and I can't continue on my way. As long as I move a little bigger, the pain will be excruciating.
There is no doctor here, so Ye Feng can only start self-rescue work.
Enduring the severe pain, he broke many thin and straight branches.
Then he tore the clothes into sections of cloth and connected them to each other as gauze for binding.
After doing all this, he chewed a wooden stick, sat cross-legged, and entered a state of inner vision.
Then through palm stroking and internal inspection, three broken ribs were identified.
Finally, the broken bone is slowly reset.
Every slight touch on the broken bone site will cause severe pain, as if thousands of steel needles are piercing into the bone marrow, which is unbearable.
The pain burned in his body like fire, and the surrounding muscles and nerves seemed to be affected, making it very difficult for Ye Feng to even breathe.
Fortunately, he finally withstood it and reset all three broken bones by letting out dozens of pig-like screams after biting the wooden stick in his mouth.
At this moment, Ye Feng's face was pale, and there were beads of sweat on his forehead, cheeks, and neck.
"It fucking hurts!"
He took a short rest, then picked up the wooden sticks he had collected earlier and used them as a fixing board. He used the connected strips of cloth as gauze to wrap and fix it to prevent the broken bones from shifting again.
After doing all this, he was almost exhausted from exhaustion. He slowly lay down on his back, gasping for air as he looked at the disciples who were practicing sword flying in the early morning, and the colorful light formed in the sky.
As the body slowly stabilized, the burning pain gradually weakened, but it was still very painful.
Therefore, Ye Feng thought of practicing martial arts to heal his injuries.
Although he didn't know the cultivation method, the original owner was at the third level of Hundred Meridians Realm and was only one step away from the sword flying realm, so he still had some true spiritual power in his Dantian.
Ye Feng closed his eyes, constantly adjusted his breathing, and then slowly mobilized the spiritual energy in his meridians and Dantian to slowly nourish the broken bones.
Immediately, a cool feeling came over me, and the pain was immediately reduced by half.
Seeing that this method really worked, Ye Feng was overjoyed.
"I'm a fucking genius!"
There is a folk saying that it takes a hundred days to break your muscles and bones.
This is only for mortals who have no cultivation.
title_en: Chapter 5 Three broken ribs Chapter 6 The elixir was stolen and Ye Feng guarded and stole it
